BC-01 · Blockchain

Smart contract development

Smart contracts, blockchain applications and private-network proofs of concept.

Discuss your project

Blockchain is useful when several parties need to trust a shared record without trusting each other. KT INDIA helps decide whether that applies to you, then builds it.

Work covers smart contracts, decentralised applications, private blockchain networks and utility-oriented digital ecosystems, starting with a proof of concept.

A good fit when

  • Several organisations need one trusted record.
  • You want to test a blockchain idea before investing in it.
  • You need a private network rather than a public chain.

What this covers

  • Smart contracts
  • Decentralised applications (dApps)
  • Private blockchain networks
  • Proofs of concept
  • Utility-oriented digital ecosystems

Every project is scoped to the requirement. [Client to confirm typical deliverables, e.g. documentation, source code handover, support period.]

Process

How the work runs

  1. 01

    Discover / Research

    Define the real problem, the users and the constraints before choosing a technology.

  2. 02

    Engineer / Build

    Design and build across software, electronics and AI, using whichever combination fits.

  3. 03

    Validate / Evidence

    Test against the requirement with data, not assumptions. Evidence before assumption.

  4. 04

    Deliver / Impact

    Ship a working system, document it and support it as it is used.
